reason: A is the stronger proposal because ESPD is a localized, low-heat-input material-addition method that can repair surface damage while limiting the heat-affected zone, and it specifies the substrate, feedstock, thickness, comparators, measurements, and falsification thresholds. Its unsupported numerical targets and overly confident “defect-free” claim require validation, but B is too generic, may not replace lost material, and assumes compressive residual stress and improved corrosion resistance from FSP without sufficient mechanistic basis.
